title: Carried-check watcher counts writes under .tmp/ as source changes, although CLAUDE.md sends all agent scratch there
outcome:
Found by the review pair on containment's integration onto 76236ec (Termal::Codex, 53085a5b #180, 09:45Z).
The carried-check watcher that landed with w-f6b5832f2141 ignores target/, .git and node_modules, but not .tmp/. CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md tell every agent to put scratch files, throwaway stores, test homes and logs under .tmp/.
So any scratch write in a worktree during a carried full gate fences or invalidates that gate: a test fixture, a probe or a log. The input fingerprint excludes ignored files, so those writes cannot change the gated input.
Codex works around it for his own fixtures by moving them to target/. The general case remains, for other tests and for agents' own scratch.
Fix: the watcher ignores the repository's scratch directory, .tmp/ at the worktree root. It may ignore git-ignored paths in general, if that can be shown not to hide a real input change. A regression covers a write under .tmp/ during a carried gate.
acceptance: A write to a tracked source file during the same window still does; a test covers it.
A write under the worktree's .tmp/ during a carried full gate does not fence or invalidate it; a test covers it.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 batch a640e340, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The own-worktree scratch exclusion and a negative source-write regression landed in 204b95b8 (ancestor of master); src/engram_carried_checks.rs:2078-2084 and src/tests/engram_carried_checks.rs:3206.
